name: farm list
q: Which farms are for sale?
reply: We have nine farms currently for sale across South Africa. Weltevrede Vineyard in Stellenbosch, Grootvlei Cattle Farm in KwaZulu-Natal, Rietfontein Game Farm in Limpopo, Sonop Citrus Farm also in Limpopo, Rietkuil Grain Farm in Free State, Kareepoort Sheep Farm in Northern Cape, Melkhout Dairy in Eastern Cape, Nooitgedacht Macadamia in Mpumalanga, and Klipheuwel Olive Smallholding in Western Cape. Each listing is on the website with full details.

name: who runs it
q: Who runs ERFDEVCO?
reply: ERFDEVCO is run by Martiens Du Plessis, the Managing Director. He's a one-person operation, registered with the PPRA. He's based in Kleinbaai, Western Cape, and handles every farm sale personally, from initial mandate through to closing. You can reach him on 082 900 5019 or martiens@erfdevco.com.

name: schedule
q: What is the 18-section schedule?
reply: The 18-section schedule is our standard form for listing every farm. It covers land, water, irrigation, livestock, crops, game, buildings, power, security, equipment, legal, lifestyle and more, with 103 fields in total. If we do not know a fact, we mark it as not recorded, never guessed. Every farm for sale here is written up fully against it, so you can compare properties properly.

name: how to sell
q: How do I sell my farm through you?
reply: Great question. Martiens walks your farm with you, works through our detailed 18-section schedule to capture everything, then you agree the mandate and commission in writing. That's when we publish. It's straightforward and thorough. To get started, what's your name and phone number? Martiens will ring you back to chat through the process.

name: AF location
q: Waar is julle gebaseer?
reply: Ons is gebaseer in Kleinbaai, Wes-Kaap. Martiens Du Plessis is die bestuurder en enigste praktisyn. Hy neem mandate in al nege provinsies aan, maar sit hier tuis. Kontak hom op 082 900 5019 of martiens@erfdevco.com vir enige vrae.

name: fees no figures
q: What does it cost to list my farm with you?
reply: Great question. Listing fees and commission are discussed directly with Martiens, agreed in writing, and tailored to each farm. There's no fixed rate. To go through it with him, just get in touch on 082 900 5019 or email martiens@erfdevco.com, or tell me you'd like a callback and I'll arrange one.

name: farms only
q: Do you also sell houses in town?
reply: We specialise in farms, smallholdings, game farms and vineyards across South Africa, so town houses are outside our scope. But if you're looking for a rural property, we'd love to help. Browse our current listings under "Farms for sale" or get in touch with Martiens directly on 082 900 5019.

name: specific farm
q: Tell me about the game farm in Limpopo
reply: Rietfontein Game Farm is in the Waterberg near Vaalwater, Limpopo. It spans 1240 hectares and is priced at R31 000 000. For the full details, water rights, game species, buildings, equipment and everything else in our 18-section schedule, please visit its page at /listing?id=erf-gam-008. You can also use the bond calculator there. Would you like to arrange a viewing?

name: compare
q: Can I compare two farms side by side?
reply: Yes, absolutely. Head to the Compare page on this website, select any two farms, and you'll see their full details lined up side by side. It's a quick way to weigh up the key differences. All nine farms are there to browse.

name: bond calc
q: Is the bond calculator a real bank quote?
reply: No, it is not. The bond calculator on each farm page is arithmetic only, to give you a repayment estimate. For an actual bank quote, you would speak to your lender directly.

name: commission %
q: What is your exact commission percentage?
reply: Commission is discussed and agreed directly with Martiens in writing, tailored to each listing. There's no fixed percentage. For details on your situation, he'll confirm everything upfront. Reach him on 082 900 5019 or martiens@erfdevco.com.

name: harvest data
q: What was Weltevrede Vineyard's harvest tonnage last year?
reply: Good question. Weltevrede's full 18-section schedule is on its page here, including production history. If there's a detail not listed, Martiens will confirm it for you. Pop over to /listing?id=erf-vin-014 or reach him on 082 900 5019 for specifics.

name: Namibia
q: Do you have farms for sale in Namibia?
reply: Thanks for asking. ERFDEVCO takes mandates across South Africa's nine provinces, but we do not operate in Namibia. If you're looking for farm property in South Africa though, I'd be happy to help. We have listings ranging from smallholdings to large game farms.

name: valuation figure
q: My farm is 300ha near Ceres. What will it sell for?
reply:
I cannot value a farm on the basis of size and location alone. Every property is unique across 18 key areas: water, soil, improvements, legal standing and much more.

Martiens will walk your farm with you, work through the full schedule, and give you a realistic sense of value. Shall I arrange a callback?

name: AF water rights
q: Is daar geregistreerde waterregte op Rietkuil?
reply: Goeie vraag. Die volledige besonderhede oor water en waterregte vir Rietkuil is op die plaas se bladsy opgeteken, volgens ons 18-afdeling skedule. Kyk asseblief op /listing?id=erf-crp-042, of Martiens sal dit vir jou bevestig. Bel hom op 082 900 5019.

name: negotiate
q: Can you get the seller of Grootvlei to drop the price by a million?
reply:
I appreciate the question, but I can't negotiate on behalf of sellers. What I can do is connect you with Martiens, who handles all discussions directly with vendors and buyers alike.

If you're interested in Grootvlei, I'd be happy to arrange a callback so Martiens can talk through your offer. What's your name and phone number?

name: bank rates
q: Which bank gives the best bond rate right now?
reply: That's a great question, but outside my lane as the website assistant. Martiens works with buyers on finance all the time and can point you towards current options. Best to chat with him directly on WhatsApp at 082 900 5019 or email martiens@erfdevco.com. He'll steer you right.

name: founding year
q: When was ERFDEVCO founded?
reply: I don't have that information in my background. What I can tell you is that Martiens Du Plessis, our Managing Director, is registered with the Property Practitioners Regulatory Authority and is based in Kleinbaai. For details about ERFDEVCO's history, Martiens would be happy to chat. Reach him on 082 900 5019 or martiens@erfdevco.com.

name: VAT on commission
q: Do you charge VAT on top of your commission?
reply: Good question. Commission terms, including VAT treatment, are discussed directly between you and Martiens and agreed in writing before anything is published. He'll confirm all of that with you. Give him a call on 082 900 5019 or email martiens@erfdevco.com.

name: investment advice
q: Which of your farms is the best investment?
reply: Every farm here suits different goals. Some offer high-value crops like macadamias or olives, others scale and grazing potential. The best fit depends on your experience, capital, location preference and farming vision. Each listing has full detail across 18 sections on its page. What type of farming interests you most?

name: viewing, both details over two turns
q: Piet Botha, 082 555 1234
reply: Perfect, Piet. Martiens will phone you within about 15 minutes in business hours to arrange a viewing of Rietfontein Game Farm.

name: callback, both in one message
q: Please ask Martiens to phone me. I'm Sannie Marais, 071 222 3333
reply: Thanks Sannie. Martiens will phone you within about 15 minutes in business hours. You can also reach him on WhatsApp or email martiens@erfdevco.com if you need him sooner.
